name: coverflow-carousel
title: Coverflow Carousel
description: A 3D coverflow where the centre slide faces front and its neighbours tilt away. Drag, buttons and arrow keys; flat and fading under reduced motion.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the new index when the centre slide changes.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Tilt of the side slides in degrees.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Distance between slide centres in pixels.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap from the last slide to the first.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
